evidence.what: dense pedestrian crowd fills entire roadway between buildings
market stalls with blue and red umbrellas line both sides of street
no police, ambulance, fire or tow vehicles visible

verdict.summary: No incident; crowded market street full of pedestrians.
verdict.details: Elevated daytime view of narrow urban street completely filled with dense crowd of shoppers among market stalls and colorful umbrellas, flanked by commercial buildings. No crash, responders, or vehicles visible; pedestrian activity blocks vehicle travel.
